title: Mum asks: tokens
hook: Mum asked me: what is a token?

beats.say: Mum again. Why does her AI say she ran out of tokens?

screen.title: Mum
screen.body: Beta my AI says I have no TOKENS left. Did I pay??

beats.say: Think of pani puri. The AI reads your words in small pieces, like puris.
Every piece is counted. Long messages, more puris. Too many, and the plate is done.
Short words, one puri! Long words, two or three!

screen.title: Mum
screen.body:
Beta my AI says I have no TOKENS left. Did I pay??

Ok. Do my good morning flowers count??

beats.say: She wants to know if her good morning flowers count.

caption:
mum asked what a token is. now she's counting her good morning flowers.

which AI word should mum ask about next?
